reply_text:
I found no dated AI prediction from Sundar Pichai in 2015. I ran the three fixed searches as written, then used 5 more searches (8 of 12) and all 6 page openings on that year's occasions. The candidates list is empty, so `quiet_year` is true.

- **Q3 2015 earnings call (22–23 October), roic.ai transcript:** It's in his own words, but nothing qualifies. "10 years from now, everything will be different again in ways no one can predict" is about computing in general, not AI. "Five to 10 years" refers to mobile reaching everyone, which isn't AI. "Over time as we use things like machine learning, I think we can make great strides" is about mobile search and has no date. The page is cut off partway through the questions, so I couldn't read his well-known "machine learning is a core, transformative way" answer there. I saw those words only in a search snippet, so I haven't quoted them.
- **Google I/O 2015 keynote (28 May), singjupost transcript:** Both pages I opened stop before his machine-learning section, so I haven't checked it.
- **Seoul talk (15 December), Korea JoongAng Daily:** This is only a news report, and its one forward-looking AI point is paraphrased and undated.
- **Delhi speech (16 December), Business Today:** Five paraphrased takeaways, none about AI.

The 4 unused searches and the cut-off pages are the main limits. Ways to close the gap: a complete Q3 2015 transcript, the rest of the I/O 2015 transcript, or the Delhi University (SRCC) Q&A on 17 December 2015, which I didn't open.
